note: A run's provenance is the SET of code versions and runtime parameters it executed under, not the one it started with. Every resume, restart and parameter change appends to that set. See CLAUDE.md section 4.

equivalence_demonstrated.claim: The two code pins and the three concurrency settings produce IDENTICAL batch outcomes, so the split does not fork the figure.
equivalence_demonstrated.method: Ran N=40 seed=4242 on the deterministic path under each condition and compared a fingerprint of every ledger row: subscription_id|arm|event_type|attempt_no|recovered|channel.
equivalence_demonstrated.why_reachability_was_not_enough: The three files changed between the pins -- cli.py, demo.py, eval/sensitivity.py -- are none of the 18 modules in the runner's transitive import closure. That is an argument about code REACHABILITY, not a demonstration of output equivalence, and this build has a rule about the difference (INC-011). So it was run under both pins and diffed.
equivalence_demonstrated.why_concurrency_invariance_holds: Draws are keyed on (seed, subscription_id, attempt_no, day_offset) rather than taken from a shared RNG whose position depends on interleaving. That keying was introduced precisely so this is demonstrable; it is now pinned by tests/test_batch_runner.py::test_concurrency_does_not_change_the_outcome, which compares OUTCOMES and not only reference_ids, and which fails on all three concurrency values when the shared RNG is restored.
